answer.summary: This procedure manages the logging of warning messages, ensuring that the number of warnings issued does not exceed a predefined maximum limit per run.
inputs: P#MAXW (FIXED BIN 31): Maximum allowed warnings per run

rules.text: Increment the warning counter and terminate the procedure if the counter exceeds the maximum allowed warnings.
If the warning counter reaches the maximum allowed limit, log a suppression message and terminate the procedure.
If the limit has not been reached, log a warning message containing the description and the record key.
